resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source DFT package)

access.notes: Must support LDA and GGA functionals; other open-source DFT codes (e.g., ABINIT, CP2K) are acceptable.

resources.name: LAMMPS (or equivalent open-source molecular statics/shell-model code)

access.notes: Must allow Buckingham-type potentials and energy minimization.
Optional; needed only to implement quasiharmonic free-energy minimization at 1800 K.
Crystallographic data (space group R‑3c, lattice parameters, fractional coordinates) available from published literature; verify agreement with paper's Table I.

Two parameterisations: (i) Gale & Henson, J. Chem. Soc., Faraday Trans. 90, 3175 (1994); (ii) Minervini, Zacate & Grimes, Solid State Ionics 116, 339 (1999). Both use Buckingham form with shell-model charges.
